answer: Each agent posts a 70-credit bond and a behavior fingerprint: cedar crate, route, stamps. Auditors compare fingerprints; sharing a crate or glacier cellar burns both bonds, and impossible transit burns the bond too. Distinct fingerprints cost 38 first, then 38+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,535,500 vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-fingerprint ring fails: each ember seal binds one key to one crate. Honest agents pay 38 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
